zh: 看两对交叉的配对：若 x≤y 且 u≤v，那么 x 配 u、y 配 v 的绝对差之和不会超过 x 配 v、y 配 u。也就是说，交叉的配对总能换成不交叉的而不变差。
反复消除交叉，最后得到的就是两边都按大小排好后按顺序一一配对，所以这种配对就是最优的。
两个数组分别升序排序，对每个下标 i 累加 |a[i]−b[i]|，输出总和。数值可以为负，总和最大约 2×10^14，用 64 位整数。
en: Look at two crossing pairs: if x ≤ y and u ≤ v, then pairing x with u and y with v gives a total absolute difference no larger than pairing x with v and y with u. In other words, a crossing pairing can always be uncrossed without getting worse.
Removing crossings repeatedly ends with both sides sorted and paired in order, so that pairing is optimal.
Sort both arrays in ascending order, add |a[i]−b[i]| for every index i, and print the total. Values can be negative and the total can reach about 2×10^14, so use 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Sort both arrays in ascending order, pair them in that order, and add up the absolute differences.

## Proof of correctness

If x≤y and u≤v, then |x−u|+|y−v|≤|x−v|+|y−u|. So any crossing pairing can be swapped into a non-crossing one without increasing the cost. Repeatedly removing crossings gives the sorted, same-order pairing, which is exactly what the algorithm builds, so it is optimal.

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), space O(n); the total cost is at most 2×10^14 and needs 64 bits.
